description: This file defines a Page Object class for automated testing of a 'Company' module page within SuiteCRM, using the Codeception testing framework. It includes static properties for page URL and module name, and a constructor that initializes a Tester object for interacting with the page during tests.

classes.name: CompanyModule
classes.description: A Page Object class representing the 'Company' module page in SuiteCRM for use in acceptance testing. It encapsulates the URL, module name, and testing setup.
